title: FlashRT-PAI: Fast Kernels Are Not Fast Pipelines for Physical AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.24349v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA), video-action (VA), and world action models (WAMs) form the backbone of modern physical AI systems, yet their real-time single-batch inference remains a defining bottleneck. Latency is dominated not by individual kernel computation, but by system-level overhead: thousands of short kernel launches, intermediate data movement across operator boundaries, and redundant recomputation across consecutive decisions. translated_title: FlashRT-PAI：快速内核并不等于面向物理AI的快速流水线
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）、视频-动作模型（VA）和世界动作模型（WAM）构成了现代物理AI系统的骨干，然而它们的实时单批次推理仍然是一个关键瓶颈。延迟并非由单个内核计算主导，而是由系统级开销决定：数千次短内核启动、跨算子边界的中间数据移动，以及连续决策之间的冗余重复计算。通用图编译器无法解决这些开销，因为它们孤立地优化单个调用，缺乏对跨调用状态语义和全局流水线结构的可见性。我们提出FLASHRT-PAI，一个围绕模型-硬件流水线协同设计而非孤立内核优化构建的低延迟推理引擎。FLASHRT-PAI结合了三种核心机制：深度内核融合与启动重叠消除了算子间边界和启动间隙；执行契约将跨调用状态（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出FlashRT-PAI低延迟推理引擎，通过深度内核融合、启动重叠和执行契约等模型-硬件流水线协同设计机制，消除物理AI系统实时推理中的系统级开销瓶颈，突破了传统孤立内核优化的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper presents FlashRT-PAI, a low-latency inference engine that overcomes system-level overhead bottlenecks in real-time physical AI inference through model-hardware pipeline co-design mechanisms (deep kernel fusion, launch overlap, and execution contracts), moving beyond isolated kernel optimization.
